messages:
mike: Promotion to canary failing post-prefetch. Multiple e2e smoke tests showing intermittent 502/504 from the shared cache during integration. Seen in two successive promo attempts. :grimacing:

deploy-bot: Promotion attempt #2 -> FAILED checks. Auto-retry suppressed due to recent error burst. CI link: https://ci.internal/redwood/job/3437129977 :robot_face:

karen: Are we back to the cache-ttl/regen issue? That race was nasty last sprint. :thinking_face:

sam: Looks related. I reproduced with `make e2e --stage=ingest -j8`. When multiple workers trigger cache regen, upstream kv-service returns 504s intermittently.

sam: Failing trace:
```
File tests/e2e/test_ingest.py:47
AssertionError: expected 200 != 504
requests.get("/v1/ingest?batch=5") -> 504 Gateway Timeout
```

jen: QA running stats: flake rate ~6.8% during today's CI runs, single-run local is stable. So bug is concurrency/TLS to kv-cache. Can run a stress sharded job on staging to confirm.

chris: The new image introduced async prefetch for kv-cache TTL refresh. If prefetch path fails, we fall back to regen which is synchronous and seems to saturate kv-service. Prefetch failure + regen storms = 5xx spike.

mike: Options: 1) Hold canary and wait for patch, 2) Roll back to last-good image `r2026-03-18-201`, 3) Pin deploybot concurrency for this window. Thoughts?

karen: If patch ETA >1h, roll back. We can't risk user-facing canaries failing.

sam: Patch is small (add jitter+exp backoff on regen). I can PR but QA cycles take ~2-3 hours.

jen: For today's release window I'd prefer roll back to last-green. We can stage the fix as a hotfix after hours.

chris: Agree roll back. Also propose adding a temporary flag: `--max-parallel-promotes=4` to deploybot to reduce blast radius until we have a better throttling solution.

mike: Decision: HOLD promotions for 15 minutes while we validate. If we don't have verified patch in 2h -> ROLLBACK to `r2026-03-18-201`. I'll draft rollback steps and ping release-notes owners.

ops-bot: Noted. Holding promotions for group "canary-ingest". Next scheduled retries suppressed.

sam: Starting jitter/backoff PR and running targeted staging stress job now. Will post results ~30m.

jen: Notifying product and release-notes. Added checklist item: "blocked by kv-cache regen flake".

karen: If rolling back, include exact image digest in the rollout message so downstream teams can pin immediately.

mike: Will do. Updating release status: HOLD -> possible rollback in 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
